an4.31:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] cattārimāni bhikkhave, cakkāni yehi samannāgatānaṃ devamanussānaṃ catucakkaṃ vattati, yehi samannāgatā devamanussā nacirasseva mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇanti bhogesu.
an4.31:1.3: patirūpadesavāso, sappurisupassayo, attasammāpaṇidhi, pubbe ca katapuññatā.
an4.31:1.4: imāni kho bhikkhave, cattāri cakkāni, yehi samannāgatānaṃ devamanussānaṃ catucakkaṃ vattati, yehi samannāgatā devamanussā na cirasseva mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇanti bhogesūti.
